text:
Maria: Quick async standup — SDK / docs / samples
Maria: Yesterday: rewrote the CLI quickstart to use the minimal flow, fixed an embedding example payload typo in docs, opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1420
Maria: Blocker: sample-app smoke tests are flaky on CI (random timeouts). Can't repro on my M1 laptop; suspect runner/network noise.
Maria: Today: land docs PR after one more lint pass, add a retry wrapper to the smoke test, and ping infra about runner timeouts.
Kevin: Thanks — I'll take the runner ping. FYI I saw similar timeouts in dedicated-tests last week, filing infra ticket now.
Kevin: Also left a small suggestion on your PR about shortening the example to avoid the long streaming output.
Ash: I can help with the smoke test retries. Suggest we use a lightweight backoff: `await wait(100 * (attempt + 1))` around the flaky step.
Sam: Quick note: sample-app uses `node 18` in CI but our docs quickstart shows `>=20`. Might explain differences on local dev. I can add a note to the README.
Maria: Good catch — I'll update the quickstart and add a compatibility callout.
Ash: If anyone hits the M1 packaging issue for wheels, try env var `CFLAGS='-march=native'` — worked for me once. Not sure if it helps CI runners.
Maria: Pinging @Kevin and @Sam for reviews once I push the last doc tweak.
Kevin: Ping received, will review after the infra ticket lands.
Sam: Leaving a tiny nit: in the sample app config snippet the header is `Authorization: Bearer {{API_KEY}}` but our SDK also supports `x-api-key`. Maybe show both?
Maria: Good idea — will show both in one-line example.
DevEx-Bot: CI status: sample-app/smoke-tests — flaky (2 failed of 6 runs) — auto-requeue scheduled.
Maria: Thanks bot. If requeue fails twice I’ll break the test into smaller steps and open a follow-up PR.
Kevin: TL;DR: Maria lands docs PR, Ash adds retry, Sam updates README; infra to investigate runner flakiness.
Maria: Thanks team :rocket: — will post updates here when PRs merge or infra replies.
